method: Manual visual reading of every original PDF page (27 pages), with complete tile crops and room associations verified against publisher artwork.
notes: Every product board is followed by its matching full-room photograph. Room views explicitly reference that following PDF page.
The source specifies 500×500mm. Series names such as PLAIN and AMBER are not invented finish values.
The gallery displays one complete square face; other random faces and coordinated LT/DK layouts remain in the original page.
